0022600009.text: The Houston Rockets (1-0), first in the Southwest and third in the West, visit the San Antonio Spurs (0-1), who are fourth in the Southwest, one game back, and 10th in the West, in the Rockets' second game of the 2026-27 season. Houston has won its only game so far, while San Antonio has lost its only game and is on a one-game losing streak, and the teams have not yet met this season. The Rockets lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 145-120 loss in San Antonio on March 8, 2026. Houston's Reed Sheppard (knee bruise) and Steven Adams (calf soreness) are both listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions, and San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain), both out.
